Engine events and fold timing, for the device test of the Fold7.

• The motion is the wallpaper's own. It cannot control Samsung's screen switch animation or the lock screen animation.
• If the new screen appears more than 3 seconds after folding (for example inside another app), the end state is shown without motion.
• One UI may keep separate wallpapers for the cover and main screens. Fold Lab records how this phone behaves.
• Packs are drawn by an on-device illustrator, not an AI model. Cloud generation and the community gallery are not part of this version.
No account, no internet permission, no analytics. Descriptions are used only while generating; the pack keeps a hash, not the text. Packs stay on this phone unless you share them.

1. Apply any pack.
2. Go home, close the phone, wait 2 s, open it. Repeat 20 times slowly and 20 times quickly.
3. Repeat from the lock screen and with Power saving on.
4. Export the trace and attach it to the POC report with the build number above.

Start delay with the screen on

When you fold or unfold with the screen on, One UI plays its own switch animation first. The fold animation waits this long so it is not over before you can see it. If it starts too late or is half gone, try another value.
